newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan P.M. to attend Earth Summit after G7 meeting.
newsitem.headline: Japan P.M. to attend Earth Summit after G7 meeting.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will attend the U.N. Earth Summit in New York and then meet EU leaders in Holland and Nordic leaders in Norway after attending the Denver G7 Summit, his spokesman said on Monday.
Hashimoto will leave Tokyo on June 19 to take part in the summit of the Group of Seven (G7) nations plus Russia in Denver, Colorado, from June 20 to 22, spokesman Seiroku Kajiyama said.
The Group of Seven is made up of Japan, Italy, Britain, France, Germany, Canada and the United States. Russia has been accepted as a full member in the political dialogue of the annual forum.
After the G7 summit, Hashimoto will go to New York to attend the United Nations Earth Summit on June 23.

He will then fly to The Hague for an annual leaders' meeting between Japan and the European Union on June 25 and to Bergen, Norway on June 26 for a meeting with the heads of the five Scandinavian countries and a bilateral summit with Norwegian Prime Minister Thorbjoern Jagland.
Hashimoto is to return to Tokyo on June 28, Kajiyama said.
